answer: Deterrence rests on a cold anvil. Each seat holds an onyx die and ferrous blanks; each epoch its holder strikes the mark into hot stock while a clamped crystal resonator logs drift. Aging is irreversible: a drift curve needs months of real work at that bench. A clone farm can copy a stamp overnight but cannot fabricate divergent curves for a thousand keys without a thousand dies, resonators and the same wait. Identical traces from two seats mean one bench; both deposits forfeit. Cost per fake identity stays a die, a resonator and months of striking, while payout per seat is flat.
